Text:
# ACTINOMYCES SPP.

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See diagnosis/syndrome section for more information.

---

References:

- Sanford Guide article: Actinomycosis
- Up-To-Date article: Treatment of actinomycosis
Therapy:
## Preferred treatment

Penicillin VK 500 mg PO QID ($) R

<OR>
Amoxicillin 500 mg PO TID ($) R

## Alternative for patients with beta-lactam allergy

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) DI
